title: Search term echoed into a template without escaping
description: A template stops using esc_html() and concatenates the raw query-string parameter into the echoed markup.
context: $_GET['wfb_q'] is attacker-controllable via a crafted link. The template is rendered on a public page and no output buffering filter escapes it later.
diff:
diff --git a/wp-content/plugins/wfb-demo/templates/search-results.php b/wp-content/plugins/wfb-demo/templates/search-results.php --- a/wp-content/plugins/wfb-demo/templates/search-results.php +++ b/wp-content/plugins/wfb-demo/templates/search-results.php @@ -1,9 +1,9 @@
-

You searched for:

+

You searched for: ' . $_GET['wfb_q'] . ''; ?>

expected_findings.description: The query-string parameter wfb_q is echoed without escaping, producing reflected cross-site scripting.
